rules.name: Department Emphasis Coursework
rules.desc: Students should complete a minimum of 10 units from the courses listed below. Departmental courses may fulfill the requirements for more than one emphasis. You will work with your faculty advisor to select emphasis courses related to a plan of study with a specific focus on a theoretical and/or geographical area.

children.name: Cultural & Social Anthropology Emphasis
children.desc: Departmental courses outside of this list may be counted toward emphasis but will need faculty advisor approval. For non-departmental courses, faculty advisor approval is needed along with a petition to the Undergraduate Committee via the Undergraduate Exception Form found on the department website.

children.desc: Departmental courses outside of this list may be counted toward emphasis but will need faculty advisor approval. children.name: Medical Anthropology Emphasis
children.desc: Departmental courses outside of this list may be counted toward emphasis but will need faculty advisor approval. children.name: Self-Designed Emphasis
children.desc: Undergraduates may also request an exception from the undergraduate committee for a self-designed emphasis in the Anthropology minor by submitting the Undergraduate Course Exception Form found on the department website.

rules.name: Anthropology Elective Coursework
rules.desc:
The remainder of the 30 required units may be fulfilled with any Anthropology courses, or a combination of Anthropology courses and up to successfully petitioned 10 units from related areas of study, overseas studies, and/or transfer units.
No more than 5 units of directed reading-style/ research coursework listed may be counted toward the minor.
